articles.title: Going Dutch Season 2 E04: "None of the Good Guys" Preview: Sabotage?
articles.summary: FOX's series 'Going Dutch,' featuring Denis Leary and Taylor Misiak, airs its Season 2, Episode 4 titled 'None of the Good Guys' tonight. The episode promises a narrative centered around 'bad men and bad guys.' This new installment continues the popular television drama's run, offering viewers the latest developments in its ongoing storyline.

articles.title: HII CEO touts productivity gains—but says new contracts are needed to sustain progress
articles.summary: A major U.S. military shipbuilder reported increased production for 2025 but warned of potential delays in submarine construction. The company stated that building schedules could slip significantly if the U.S. Navy doesn't award crucial new contracts by midyear. This highlights potential challenges in defence procurement and maintaining naval readiness, impacting future fleet capabilities and national security.

articles.title: Russia, Ukraine exchange 300 prisoners as US peace talks end without breakthrough
articles.summary: Russia and Ukraine have agreed to release 157 prisoners of war from each side following recent talks involving the US. While analysts suggest this exchange might be largely symbolic, it marks a significant step in ongoing diplomatic efforts amidst the conflict. This development offers a glimmer of hope for future humanitarian initiatives and de-escalation, even as broader peace remains elusive.

articles.title: mrrc added to PyPI
articles.summary: A new Rust library, featuring Python bindings, has been developed for efficiently reading, writing, and manipulating MARC bibliographic records. This project is significant for library and information science, enabling advanced data management. Notably, its creation leveraged 'agentic coding tools,' highlighting advancements in AI-assisted software development and demonstrating innovative approaches to complex technical challenges.

articles.title: Parshat Yitro: What inspired Yitro in the war with Amaleik?
articles.summary: This week's Parshah introduces Yitro, described as history's first convert to the Jewish people. As Moshe's father-in-law for decades, Yitro was inspired to join after learning about the miraculous splitting of the sea. This narrative highlights a significant moment of spiritual conversion and historical faith within religious texts, detailing a foundational event for the Jewish people.
